book.name: Lukas
book.title: Ramatua Yesus Tutui Malole na tuka Lukas susura na

content: Malaka agama Yahudi a malaka nara saka enoꞌ fo nau raisa Ramatua Yesus

Lahenda Yahudi ra fai malole fo riꞌ rae feta Roti Tua-lepa naneaꞌ so. Nai fai malole ria, ara pau bibi-lopo fo tao feta Paska. Ara tao leo naꞌ ela rafarene fai a ulu na, tepoꞌ fo bei-baꞌi nara kalua reme Masir mai a.
Faiꞌ ria, malaka agama Yahudi a malaka nara, ma mesen agama ra rasaka enoꞌ fo nau raisa Yesus. Tehuu ara biiꞌ lahenda kadodou inaꞌ sira tao isuoteꞌ, huu fo ara rahiiꞌ ramanene neuꞌ Ana.
Yudas seꞌo heni Ramatua Yesus
Neme Yesus ana mana tuka dea kasanahulu dua nara, esa nade Yudas Iskariot. Fai fo malaka agama Yahudi a malaka nara saka enoꞌ ela raisa Yesus, malaka nitu maso neuꞌ Yudas dale na.
Basa de ana kalua neu saka malaka agama a malaka nara, ma manea Uma Mamaso Ina a malaka na. Ana nau rala haraꞌ fo seꞌo Yesus fee si.
Malaka sira ramanene Yudas dedea nae leoꞌ na, boe ma ara ramahoꞌo mamateꞌ. Ara helu rae, “Neu! Maneniko o nau seꞌo Yesus fee ami, tantu ami bae.”
Yudas nataa. Boe ma ana mulai saka enoꞌ fo seꞌo nafufuniꞌ Yesus fee si, ela lahenda kadodou inaꞌ ara bosoꞌ bubuluꞌ.
Ramatua Yesus ana mana tuka dea nara sadia feta Paska
Boe ma losa lahenda Yahudi ra fai malolen fo riꞌ biasa ara pau bibi-lopo fo tao feta Paska.
Boe ma, Yesus nadenu Petrus no Yohanis nae, “Emi dua meu mauluꞌ fo sadia fee ita nanaaꞌ feta Paska a, ela taa sama-sama.”
Dua si ratane Ni rae, “Papa! Ami meuꞌ bea sadia mei a?”
Ana nataa nae, “Maneniko emi masoꞌ leo kota Yerusalem a daleꞌ meu, neuꞌ ko maneta mo touꞌ esa nasaa neni kusi oe. Tuka ni leo uma meu.
Mafada manuu umaꞌ na mae, ‘Ami Papa Mesen ma hule kama fo ela ana mana tuka dea nara raa feta Paska reuꞌ na. Hapu, do?’
Neuꞌ ko manuu umaꞌ a natudu fee emi kama maloa esa nai uma a tadaꞌ lain. Ana sadia na basa-basan nai kama ria so. Emi dua meuꞌ na, fo sadia noi nanaaꞌ.”
Boe ma dua si reu. Ara raneta ro basa-basan fo Yesus nafada siꞌ a. De ara sadia feta Paska reuꞌ na.
Feta Paska
Faiꞌ fo basan mana sadiaꞌ, boe ma Yesus asa mai. Ana natuuꞌ naa feta Paska sama-sama no ana mana tuka dea nara.
Boe ma Yesus nafada si nae, ‘Au ahiiꞌ an seli atuu oo emi ua feta Paska ia, nauluꞌ neme Au hapu doidoso a.
Tanda matalolole ia. Huu fo basa ia, te Au ta atuuꞌ seluꞌ oo emi, ua feta Paska ia soꞌ. Neuꞌ ko lahenda bubuluꞌ matetuꞌ Au Papa Ka homu pareta a, besaꞌ ko Au ua seluꞌ feta bali.”
Boe ma Yesus hai na galas fo oe anggor nai daleꞌ. Ana hule makasi neuꞌ Manetualain, boe ma Ana loo fee si galas ria. Ana dedea nae, “Sipo ma galas ia, fo emi esa-esa minuu.
Mafarereneꞌ! Mulai neme hatun ia mai, Au ta inuu oe anggor soꞌ. Neuꞌ ko lahenda bubuluꞌ matetuꞌ Au Papa Ka homu pareta, besaꞌ ko Au inu bali.”

Basa de Ana hai na roti baloꞌ esa, boe ma Ana hule makasi neuꞌ Manetualain. Ana tetebi roti ria, boe ma loo fee si. Ana nae, “Roti ia nana, Au ao-paa ka fo Au fee henin neuꞌ emi basa. Fai bea ma emi mia roti ia, emi muste mafarene neuꞌ Au.”
Ara raa basa, boe ma Ana soꞌu na galas fo oe anggor nai daleꞌ. Ana dedea bali nae, “Anggor ia nana, Au daa ka, fo faa neni fee emi sodaꞌ a. Manetualain pake daa ia ela heke hehelu bebeuꞌ no emi.
Tehuu besa-besa, te lahenda fo seꞌo heni Au a, ana natuuꞌ sama-sama no Au nai mei ia.
Tebe Au, Ana Lahenda, muste mate tuka Manetualain hihi-nanaun. Tehuu soe neuꞌ lahenda fo seꞌo heni Au a!”
Yesus ana mana tuka dea nara ramanene ra ria, boe ma ara mulai ratatane aoꞌ rae, “Bea riꞌ tao tadalu neuꞌ Ana leo naꞌ?”
Ramatua Yesus ana mana tuka dea nara ralelena aoꞌ laꞌeneuꞌ bea riꞌ bau lena
Boe ma Yesus ana mana tuka dea nara mulai ralelena aoꞌ rae, neme sira mai bea rina bau lena.

Tehuu Yesus nafada si nae, “Nai nusaꞌ fo ta ralelaꞌ neuꞌ Manetualain, maneꞌ nara ese-rumu anaraun ara, ma pareta rala lenaꞌ. Sekonaa te ara nau anaraun nara raloo si rae, ‘Papa manatulu-manafali anaraun a’.

Tehuu emi ta bole leo naꞌ fa. Bea nau dadi lahenda bauinaꞌ, sona ria masoda na muste tetebes ara dadi sama leoꞌ lahenda aanaꞌ a fo nalalau basa lahenda ra. Bea nau dadi malaka muste nalalau sama leoꞌ lahenda nadedenuꞌ a.

Soba emi dodoo, lahenda bauinaꞌ a, nana riꞌ bea? Lahenda fo natuuꞌ nai mei a, do nalalauꞌ a? Tantu lahenda fo natuuꞌ a, nana ria riꞌ lahenda bauinaꞌ, hete? Sekonaa te, Au ta tao ao ka leoꞌ na fa. Au mai fo alalau emi.
Emi ia nana sama-sama mo Au kose-kose nai faiꞌ fo Au hapu doidoso a.
Au Papa ka soꞌu na Au fo homu pareta nai Ria nusa-namon. De besaꞌ ia Au soꞌu a emi boe,
fo ela neuꞌ ko emi mia-minuu mo Au mei esa nai nusatetu-ikutemaꞌ a. Au fee kuasa boe ela emi pareta leo kasanahulu duaꞌ fo rai Israel.”
Ramatua Yesus nafada nae neuꞌ ko Petrus nalena Ni
Boe ma Yesus nafada Petrus nae, “Petrus, Petrus. Malaka nitu soba nau heoꞌ heni emi meme Au mai, sama leoꞌ lahenda dai isiꞌ de here heni kataaꞌ ara.
Tehuu Au hule-haradoi fee, Petrus o, ela mamahere maroo Au. Maneniko o matafali leo Au mai, sona o muste matetea toranoo mara dale nara.”
Petrus nataa nae, “Taꞌa, Ramatuaꞌ! Au ta foa ela Ramatua ka fa. Au sadia masoꞌ bui a, ma oo Ramatua ka mate belaꞌ boe malole.”
Tehuu Yesus nataa nae, “Petrus! Nenene matalolole. Hatun ia, manuꞌ ara bei ta kokoꞌoa fa, tehuu o malena laiꞌ telu so mae, o ta malelaꞌ Au fa.”
Ramatua Yesus lahenda nara muste sadia hapu doidoso

Boe ma Yesus dedea no si nae, “Fai naa ra, Au adenu emi meu tui-beka Au Tutui Malole ka leo basa mamanaꞌ ara, Au ae bosoꞌ meni doiꞌ, tas, ma sandaal. Tepoꞌ ria, emi kura-kopo ubeaꞌ?” Boe ma ara rataa belaꞌ a rae, “Faiꞌ naa ra, ami ta kura-kopo hata esa boeꞌ!”
Boe ma Ana nafada si nae, “Tehuu besaꞌ ia fekeꞌ so. Kalu emi manuu doiꞌ, sona meni. Bea manuu tas sona meni boe. Maneniko tafaꞌ taꞌa, sona meu seꞌo heni emi badu mi bei esaꞌ, fo asa.
Huu fo lahenda Yahudi ra tao Au neuꞌ lahenda tadaluꞌ. Selu baianaꞌ ia te ara mai hopu Au so. Nana huu ria laꞌe fai hata fo baꞌi Yesaya duiꞌ memaꞌ ana, nae:

content.text: ‘Ara tao Ni sama leoꞌ lahenda tadaluꞌ!’ ”

content: Ara rafada rae, “Ramatuaꞌ! Ami meni felas dua rai ia!” Yesus nataa nae, “Dai so. Bosoꞌ boe dedea ria bali!”
Ramatua Yesus neu hule-haradoi nai lete Saitun
Raa basa Paska, boe ma Yesus no ana mana tuka dea nara kalua, reu hule-haradoi nai lete Saitun a, sama leoꞌ bale-bale.
Losa na, boe ma Ana nafada si nae, “Emi muste hule-haradoi fo ela emi bosoꞌ hapu sosobaꞌ.”
Basa de Ana oruꞌ ela si dooꞌ a baiꞌ, boe ma sundaꞌ undulaka na, fo hule-haradoi nae,
“O, Amaꞌ! Kalu Amaꞌ a nau, sona hai heni doidoso ia neme Au mai. Tehuu bosoꞌ tuka Au hihii-nanau ka; ela leoꞌ bea na tuka noi Amaꞌ a hihii-nanaum.”
[Boe ma Manetualain eilaꞌo-limalopen neme nusatetu-ikutemaꞌ a mai, de natetea dale Na.
Huu fo Ana doidoso naan seli, losaꞌ puse Na titi deaꞌ mai sama leoꞌ daa a.]
Hule-haradoi basa, boe ma Ana foa neu dama ana mana tuka dea nara. Tehuu ara suku, huu fo ara sotaꞌ raan seli, ma dale nara susa.
Boe ma Yesus nafada si nae, “Ubeaꞌ taon de emi suku?! Malole lenaꞌ emi hule-haradoi fo ela bosoꞌ tuda mala sosobaꞌ daleꞌ.”
Ara hopu ra Ramatua Yesus
Yesus bei dea-dea nae leoꞌ na, te Yudas (esa neme ana mana tuka dea kasanahulu duaꞌ ara mai), no lahenda dodouꞌ mai. Ana naneneaꞌ Yesus de nau holu nan fo deꞌi.
Tehuu Yesus nafada ni nae, “Ae, Yudas! O nau seꞌo heni Ana Lahenda neniꞌ dedeꞌi, do?”
Yesus ana mana tuka dea feke nara bubuluꞌ Yudas duduꞌa-aafi tadalun ria, boe ma ara ratane Yesus rae, “Ramatuaꞌ! Ami soaꞌ asa meni felas dei!”
Boe ma sira esa lesu na fela na, de tati naetu malaka agama Yahudi a malaka bauinan atan ridoo onan.
Tehuu Yesus nafada nae, “Nemeꞌ na leo! Bosoꞌ soaꞌ asa!” Boe ma Ana nafaroe lahenda ria ridoo na, de puli nan.

Lahenda fo mai hopu Yesus nana siꞌ: malaka agama Yahudi a malaka nara, lasi nara, ma Uma Mamaso Ina a manea nara. Yesus natane si nae, “Leo beaꞌ? Emi dale mara mae Au, lahenda tadaluꞌ, losaꞌ emi mai hopu Au pake tafaꞌ, ma ai tutukuꞌ?
Tuka-tuka faiꞌ Au anori-afada emi nai Uma Mamaso Ina a, tehuu ta hapu lahenda esa mai fo hopu na Au boeꞌ. Tehuu nemeꞌ na! Ia, nana emi ledo-faim. Besaꞌ ia malaka nitu kuasan ia!”
Petrus nalena neuꞌ Ramatua Yesus
Ara hopu ra Yesus, de hela roo Ni leo malaka agama Yahudi a malaka bau-ina na uma na neu. Petrus boe tuka nafufuniꞌ nesiꞌ deaꞌ.
Nai uma ria mata na hapu lahenda raseraꞌ ai. Petrus neuꞌ na namaneru ai boe.
Hapu ata inaꞌ esa nita Petrus natuuꞌ naneneaꞌ ai ria. Ana bebesa natalolole Petrus mata-idun, boe ma nafada lahenda fekeꞌ fo rai na nae, “Ae! Lahenda ia boe ana tutukaꞌ Yesus!”
Tehuu Petrus nalena nae, “Taꞌa! Au ta alelaꞌ Lahenda ria fa. O bubuluꞌ ubea?”
Ta doo bea boeꞌ, te lahenda esa mete leo Petrus neu, boe ma dedea nae, “Tebe, o nana Yesus lahenda nara esa ian, hete?” Tehuu Petrus nadedealaka nae, “Taꞌa! O mafararaꞌuꞌ!”
Bate basa jam esa, boe ma lahenda fekeꞌ esa dedea bali nae, “Ae! Au bubuluꞌ, lahenda ia nana, Yesus ana mana tuka dean esa ian, huu fo ria lahenda Galilea boe.”
Tehuu Petrus nalena mamateꞌ nae, “O maa ma ria!” Laꞌe fai Petrus dedea nae leoꞌ na, boe ma manuꞌ ara kokoꞌoa.
Boe ma Yesus lipe ao na fo mete ni. Basa de Petrus nafarene Yesus nafada ni nae, “Hatun ia, manuꞌ ara bei ta kokoꞌoa boeꞌ, tehuu o malena Au laiꞌ telu so.”
Petrus nafarene na ria, boe ma ana kalua neme uma a mata na mai ma dola nasaeꞌedu.
Ara popoꞌo ma ramumulu-ramamaeꞌ Ramatua Yesus
Basa ria, boe ma lahenda fo ranea Yesus a, ara mulai ramamaeꞌ Ana ma fepa-leꞌu Ni.
Ara poti etu mata Na pake temaꞌ, ma ratanen rae, “Ae! Kalu O nana Manetualain mana nesi matan, sona maneuꞌ masudin! Bea rina popoꞌo O ia?”
Ara ramumulu-ramamaeꞌ rahedi Ni.
Ramatua Yesus nai mamana parisa dedea agama
Balahaa anan ria, malaka agama Yahudi a malaka nara, mesen agama, ma lasi nara tesa fo parisaꞌ Yesus dedea na. Boe ma ara radenu fo lahenda ra, hela roo Yesus leo mamana parisa dedea agama a neu.
Ana masoꞌ leo daleꞌ neu, boe ma ara ratane Ni rae, “Soba O mafada dei! O ia nana tetebe sara Kristus, do?” Tehuu Yesus nataa nae, “Leo mae Au ataa ae tebe boe, emi ta mamahere fa.
Boe ma maneniko Au atane emi hihii-nanauꞌ esa, tantu emi ta mataa fa.
Ta dooꞌ a soꞌ, te Manetualain nau pake Ria kuasa kahere na, fo soꞌu na aeꞌ Au, Ana Lahendaꞌ ia. Basa te Au atuuꞌ nai Ria boboa ona na fo oo Ni pareta sama-sama.”
Ramanene leoꞌ na, boe ma basa si ratane rae, “Kalu leoꞌ na, sona O nana Manetualain Anan, do?” Boe ma Yesus nataa nae, “Memaꞌ, tebe leoꞌ emi dedeam ria.”

Boe ma lahenda mana parisa dedeaꞌ sira rahara belaꞌ a rae, “Ita basa tamanene mataꞌ, hete? Ana soꞌu aon nae Ria nana Manetualain Anan. Namumulu-namamaeꞌ ia! Tuka ita atoran agama na, kalu hapu lahenda tao aon sama leoꞌ Manetualain, lahenda ria muste mate. De, leoꞌ bea? Ita ta parluu mana sakasii soꞌ. Huku mateꞌ Ana leo.”

footnotes.text: Nai duduiꞌ dedea Yunani, ara seseiꞌ Petrus nade feke na riꞌ Simon.
Dudui dedea Yunani mauluꞌ a ma malole inaꞌ a ta duiꞌ lalane kahaa hulu telu na losa kahaa hulu haa na fa.
